# Which classes on your timetable are losing you money?

> Free class timetable optimizer for fitness, yoga, pilates and dance studios. Paste your attendance log to see which slots lose money, your break-even class size, and which classes are full enough to double. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
